card.title: SPITFIRE Mk V
card.flavorText: Late in 1940, the RAF predicted a high altitude bombing offensive by the Luftwaffe, in which case a development of a pressurized version of the Spitfire was needed to counter this, with a new version of the Merlin engine. As a result, the Spitfire Mk V was designed and produced in 1941 and it was a Mk I with the Merlin 45 series engine. Three versions of the Mk V were produced and several sub-series.
